description: This file defines an interface for handling AWS Resource Names (ARNs). It specifies methods for parsing ARNs and retrieving their components, serving as a contract for classes implementing ARN parsing and storage.

classes.name: ArnInterface
classes.description: An interface defining methods for parsing and representing AWS ARN strings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into an ARN object representation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ARN.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Retrieves the partition component of the ARN.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the service component of the ARN.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the region component of the ARN.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves the resource component of the ARN.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the ARN components as an array.
